main.description: The domains of one of the caller's instances: its platform subdomain and any custom domain. Customers only.

domains.description: The custom domains, at most one today.

requestedPrimary.description: The hostname the primary is switching to, while a switch is in flight. Absent otherwise. The primary flags keep describing the live primary until the instance has restarted onto it.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not a HappyProto customer, or the provisioner refused them.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such instance or domain, or it is not the caller's. The cases are indistinguishable.

errors.name: NotAvailable
errors.description: Custom domains are not switched on yet.

errors.name: OperationInProgress
errors.description: Passed through from the provisioner: the instance is already changing, or a request with this idempotencyKey is still running.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers, or the job could not be started.

domain.description: A custom domain on one of the caller's instances.

hostname.description: The hostname, lowercase, internationalized names in punycode.

state.description: pending: waiting for the DNS records. verified: proven and served. lapsed: the TXT record went missing, and HappyProto stopped serving it; it recovers if the record comes back before expiresAt.

primary.description: Whether this is the instance's primary domain, the one its PUBLIC_URL follows.

records.description: The DNS records the customer publishes: the TXT that proves ownership, then the CNAME that points the hostname at the instance.

checks.description: The latest DNS check. Absent until the first check has run.

serving.description: Whether the domain actually works: off until it is verified, issuing while its certificate is ordered, live once it serves over HTTPS.

lapsesAt.description: When HappyProto stops serving the domain if its TXT record stays missing. Absent while the record is present.

expiresAt.description: When a pending claim expires if it is never verified. Absent once verified.

verifiedAt.description: When the domain was first verified.

alt.description: For an apex name, which cannot hold a CNAME: the A record to publish instead. Absent when the instance's host has no public IPv4.

ownership.description: Whether the TXT record carries this claim's token.

pointing.description: Whether the hostname resolves to the instance's host. Absent when the check didn't get that far, such as when the TXT record was missing.

hostname.description: The instance's own <slug>.hpy.at hostname, which always serves it.

primary.description: Whether it is the instance's primary domain.
